steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each entry is placed by its owner and its due date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Dependency with no counterpart
findings.fix: Name the counterpart and agree the date

findings.title: Due date passed
findings.fix: Re-date the entry or close it

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[high] raid-d-04.md:12  Dependency with no counterpart.
       Fix: Name the counterpart and agree the date.
[medium] raid-i-03.md:19  Due date passed.
       Fix: Re-date the entry or close it.
[low] raid-r-05.md:26  Risk with no response.
       Fix: Record the response.
Not checked: Whether the risk is real.
pros: Checks an entry with no owner, a due date past, a dependency with no counterpart, and a risk with no response.
cons: Not checked: Whether the risk is real.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-raid-log skill on the records for this review.
